alt: 孩子一開始報告就指向大圖，圖中髒池塘變成清澈魚池，旁邊放著清潔手套和夾子，同學們坐好專心聆聽。
scene_prompt: A child begins a classroom presentation about cleaning a littered pond. At the very front of the presentation, the child immediately points to one large central visual on an easel showing a dirty pond changing into a clean pond with happy fish, using only pictures. Beside the easel are cleanup gloves and a litter picker to clarify the main purpose. Classmates have only just sat down and attentively face the opening visual; a folder of later supporting picture cards remains closed on the desk. Emphasize announcing the central purpose immediately at the beginning; no speech text, no letters, no numbered slides, no blank writing sheets.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, Prefer modern everyday settings and original people in present-day casual clothes, except when the specific scene below calls for historical clothing or nature. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper.
